title: A Robust Binary Nonlinear Solver for Multi-stage Decisions
summary: This document describes two developments. The first is a Multi-stage Decision Framework that permits the formulation of various sequential decision-making problems in a generic manner. The second concerns a robust stochastic solution procedure designed to handle the binary nonlinear optimization problem stemming from the proposed decision framework. The method adopts Monte-Carlo search with incremental probabilistic learning with reinforcement. The two developments are described herein along with a demonstrative application example. Key words: Multi-stage, decisions, binary, nonlinear…
